name: Realistic 3D
description: Photoreal 3D shorts rendered in Blender: a MakeHuman character with a real face and expressions in a set built from real assets, filmed like a documentary on a phone, with slow straight camera moves, bloom, grain and motion blur. For 'what if…' stories, comedy shorts and explainers with a character; the same scene also renders as claymation or a tilt-shift miniature.

voice.direction: A warm, playful storyteller, about 2.8 words a second, deadpan on the jokes. Open with a hypothetical ('If you…', 'What happens when…'). Spell numbers out for the voice; captions keep the digits.

music.prompt: light quirky documentary underscore, plucked strings, soft marimba and ukulele, gentle pulse, warm and curious, instrumental, no vocals

sfx: ambience under every shot (sea and wind, a room tone, a street)
fast smooth cinematic whoosh on every whip or zoom transition
UI ticks and error buzzes on phone and laptop screens
close foley for what the hands do (sand scratch, keyboard, a knock)
an awkward-silence beat (crickets) after a joke lands
